The agent remembers, and every step is a checkpoint
langgraph-oracledb, in the agent user's own schema; the chart stays read-only
Who writes memory: the runner records each accepted brief; the web app records each clinician decision.
The model reads it and builds on it; it cannot write it, so memory holds facts the system can stand behind.
